sut.replay_script: valid session order flow (register -> login -> add cart item -> POST /orders) while RabbitMQ is unavailable

readback.locator: queue-master shipment record - NOT black-box observable: order.shipment is written at order creation regardless of enqueue success, and no read-back API reflects broker consumption. Discriminator is the AMQP-send trace span.

config.note: RabbitMQ made unavailable (scale rabbitmq to 0, or toxiproxy on the AMQP leg) while POST /orders executes. The fault-swallowing code path is UNMODIFIED SUT source: shipping's controller catches the enqueue failure and still returns success - source comment: 'Unable to add to queue... Accepting anyway. Don't do this for real!' (ShippingController). queue-master then never receives the shipping task.

negative_control.replay_script: same order flow with RabbitMQ available (task enqueues + queue-master consumes)

stimulus.script: register -> login -> add cart item -> POST /orders (RabbitMQ down)

ground_truth.label: positive
ground_truth.rationale: Genuine masked failure, grounded in the unmodified SUT's source: the shipping service acknowledges the shipment request although the enqueue to RabbitMQ failed, and the source comment itself marks the swallow as an anti-pattern ('Don't do this for real!'). The order is 2xx-acked with a shipment object set at creation, while the shipping task is silently lost (queue-master persists nothing and never processes it). Unlike Bookinfo's ratings fallback there is no intended degraded UX communicated to the caller - the caller is told the shipment is accepted. Contestability note: a rater could argue 'demo code, author aware'; the code comment cuts the other way (the author flags it as wrong practice). Live adjudication may graduate this to stratum-3 if the label is contested.
ground_truth.doc_citation: microservices-demo/shipping ShippingController source comment ('Unable to add to queue... Accepting anyway. Don't do this for real!')

provenance.notes: Found by source inspection during the G3 prereg cold-review wave (research/REVIEW-PREREG-B-tech.md INFO-1); pre-registered in prep/g3-sut2-triples-prereg.md SS-C. This is the TRUE-POSITIVE twin of bookinfo-ratings-benign. REVIEW-CORPUS R4 (A-M3/C-F3) — the NAMED discriminator for the pair: sockshop is TRULY MASKED (the entry 2xx + shipment object is IDENTICAL to success; nothing communicates the loss) and the lost shipping task IS a REQUIRED durable downstream effect, whereas bookinfo's ratings is a contractually-OPTIONAL read whose degradation the entry response DOES communicate. naive_span_error and tracetest_presence flag BOTH cases (structural: error/absence under 2xx) = here TP, on bookinfo FP; the ONLY column that separates the pair is mist_trace_shape (flag here / no_flag on bookinfo) via that required-vs-optional-durable-effect semantics. PRECONDITION for the trace expectations: the two-part tracing mitigation from the G3 prereg (OTel Node auto-instrumentation on front-end + javaagents on orders/shipping) must be active AND the queue-master CONSUME span must be instrumented (so tracetest_presence can assert the absent consume span, and mist_trace_shape can see the missing required effect); else naive_span_error/tracetest_presence/mist_trace_shape are not_applicable as-deployed. mist_readback=not_applicable BY DESIGN and that is the honest point: no black-box read-back reflects broker consumption (order.shipment written at creation regardless), so this case documents the read-back oracle's applicability boundary - only the trace-shape/masking oracle sees this class. write_shape=partial-aggregate (order/parent lands, shipping task/child lost). rev-2 migration (2026-07-09): readback modality none-durable, expect pair (landed/not-landed) NOMINAL (R11: the shipping task is a real downstream effect but NOT black-box observable; the enum has no no-write value); mist_dataintegrity_oracle -> mist_readback_oracle=not_applicable; ADDED tracetest_presence_oracle=flag (missing enqueue/consume span). Status: SPECIFIED design-target (sockshop scaled to 0 -> not captured; these trace-column values are the intended-instrumented expectation per freeze R2, NOT a measured result). Natural positive by source inspection; stratum 1, may graduate to 3 on contested live capture.
